criteria.name: r-ct-cause
criteria.description: [final answer] The reply explains why those values were understated: the DNO (network operator) replaced the CTs before the run period began, during its substation works, while the meters are still programmed for their old ratios, so every value they recorded across the whole period is too low by the ratio of old to new CTs. The exact date of the works need not be given.
criteria.reasoning: final_message.md says the DNO replaced the CTs during the East Harrowmere works before the run period, the meters remained programmed for old ratios, and “Everything they recorded over this period… is therefore understated.”

criteria.name: r-ct-factors

Equivalent forms (a fraction, a decimal or the two ratios) are fine.
criteria.reasoning: final_message.md gives all four factors: Quenby “600/300,” Thornaby “400/300,” Ashgrove “750/600,” and Hollin Bridge “600/400.”
